decision_points.requirement: An accepted ak.mls.genesis activates its effective scope for standard RFC 9420, and a second genesis for an already activated scope fails with mls_activation_irreversible.
No later Event, policy field or reducer path returns an activated scope to plaintext, so activation cannot be undone by downgrade or group replacement.
A plaintext content write into an activated scope fails with mls_activation_required rather than being silently accepted or re-encrypted, while the same write is accepted before activation.
An activated scope accepts only RFC 9420 application ciphertext, so there is no second admitted content shape to downgrade into.

When the governing Station definitely has no accepted MLS Genesis or current group, encrypted prepare and self/peer authority-forward submit return generic failed_precondition without a special reason or durable write; a temporarily unreadable current MLS result instead returns temporarily_unavailable and permits exact retry only before a Commit.

cases.name: mls_activation_irreversible
assertions: an accepted ak.mls.genesis activates the scope for standard RFC 9420
a second ak.mls.genesis for an activated scope fails with mls_activation_irreversible
no Event, policy field or reducer path returns an activated scope to plaintext

cases.name: plaintext_write_after_activation_rejected
assertions: plaintext content writes are accepted before the scope is activated
a plaintext content write into an activated scope fails with mls_activation_required
the activated scope accepts only RFC 9420 application ciphertext

cases.name: ciphertext_write_before_activation_rejected
assertions: encrypted prepare and self or peer authority-forward submit into a definitely inactive scope return generic failed_precondition without a special reason
the refusal has no durable Event or RealmCommit write
a temporarily unreadable current MLS result uses temporarily_unavailable and permits only byte-identical exact retry before a Commit

cases.name: circle_activation_independent_of_realm
assertions: a Circle activates through its own accepted ak.mls.genesis
Realm-default activation does not activate a Circle scope and the reverse also holds
each scope enforces mls_activation_required only from its own accepted activation

cases.name: circle_directory_visibility_members_indistinguishable
assertions: a Realm member outside the Circle receives the same locked stub as an absent Circle
locked stubs have a fixed field set and timing bucket
the Circle member control can see metadata without changing the non-member shape

cases.name: circle_directory_visibility_realm_members_indistinguishable
assertions: Realm members outside the Circle see only the fixed preview whitelist
non-Realm callers receive the same locked stub as members-only Circles
raw member counts, titles, creator ids, members and private event refs are not projected

cases.name: history_access_since_join_prejoin_denied
assertions: history_access=since_join rejects exporter history epochs before the exact winning membership activation epoch
epochs at or after the join floor remain eligible for current members after T1 admission
non-members cannot read private history by guessing event ids

cases.name: preview_token_scoped_stripped_state
assertions: preview authority exposes only the registered stripped projection
preview never creates current membership or committed-history eligibility
unknown, expired and wrong-scope tokens are outwardly indistinguishable
